LanguageData.PIT_NotifyThisMode: Notify when ready for this mode
LanguageData.PIT_TooltipVanilla: This reports RimWorld's existing interaction gate. It does not alter timing or order a warden.
LanguageData.PIT_ReasonDisabled: The selected prisoner policy does not schedule a timed interaction.
LanguageData.PIT_ReasonCooldown: The vanilla minimum interaction interval is still active.
LanguageData.PIT_ReasonDailyLimit: The prisoner has reached RimWorld's daily interaction limit.
LanguageData.PIT_ReasonIncapacitated: The prisoner is downed and not in a bed.
LanguageData.PIT_ReasonMentalState: The prisoner is in a mental state.
LanguageData.PIT_ReasonInsecure: The prisoner is not currently secure or otherwise available to wardens.
LanguageData.PIT_ReasonUnspawned: The prisoner is not currently spawned on a map.
LanguageData.PIT_ReasonNoWarden: No eligible, reachable warden with the Warden job enabled is available.
LanguageData.PIT_ReasonModeRequirement: No active interaction mode currently has its mode-specific requirements met.
LanguageData.PIT_ReasonUnknown: Waiting for a vanilla eligibility condition.
LanguageData.PIT_SettingsEnabledTooltip: Adds vanilla readiness timing and blockers to the selected prisoner's Prisoner tab.
LanguageData.PIT_SettingsFormatTooltip: Choose how remaining game time is shown.
LanguageData.PIT_SettingsReasonsTooltip: Lists all currently known vanilla blockers in the timer tooltip.
LanguageData.PIT_SettingsNotificationsTooltip: When enabled, the Prisoner tab offers an opt-in alert for the prisoner's current interaction mode. Alerts fire once per not-ready to ready transition.
